messages:
sophia: Hi all — I pushed a compact company OKR draft into the doc: https://redwood.example/okr/q3-draft. Need leadership alignment today on scope and risk triage, specifically how we prioritize: (A) inference reliability & SLA work vs (B) Private deployment expansion. Short ask: read the summary and reply with one of: +1 (signoff), carve (suggest removal of a KR), or flag (needs more debate).

mike: Quick skim — the infra SLAs are aggressive but doable if we defer a couple of Developer Experience projects. Can we mark `DX: onboarding flows` as lower priority?

anya: +1 on SLAs but want to surface sales asks: two top customers requested Private VPC support in Q3 for compliance; if we deprioritize Private, we'll risk churn.

raj: Flag — we need numbers. What does the Dedicated capacity roadmap look like if we push SLAs harder? Need a rough `FTE / infra $` delta before committing.

lisa: Carve — suggests removing KR: "complete experimental H100 pilot for all models" from the company OKR; keep it as Eng roadmap item instead. Not a company-level deliverable.

darrell: +1 to lisa. Company OKRs should be about customer impact and revenue/signals (SLA, Private, Optimize). The H100 pilot is tactical.

sophia: Noted. Proposal: move H100 pilot out of company KRs; add a KR to "reduce time-to-ship for Private infra by 2 weeks" if we accept Private priority. Thoughts?

mike: That KR seems measurable — `time-to-ship-private` baseline = 6 weeks. Target = 4 weeks. We can do this if we reduce other infra scope (batching optimizations) or add 1 IC to Platform.

anya: If we add the Private time-to-ship KR, we should also include a launch criteria checklist for customers: data residency approved, KMS integration, audit logging enabled. Otherwise sales will sign-ups but fail security review.

raj: Flag — there are risks on the SLAs + Private combo: both need capacity and SRE support. We should add a mitigation KR: create a cross-functional on-call rota for Private launch and a canary rollback policy.

clarice-legal: Quick note from legal: Private deployments require documented encryption-at-rest controls + customer contract clause updates. Need draft clause before any firm signoff.

okrbuddy-bot: Reminder: Please vote by EOD. Current votes: +1 sop: pending, mike: pending, anya: pending, lisa: pending, darrell: pending.

sophia: Updated doc: moved H100 pilot to Eng roadmap, added `Private time-to-ship` KR and a mitigation KR for canary/rollback. Also appended the launch checklist (see appendix B). Link: https://redwood.example/okr/q3-draft#appendix-b

mike: I can own the platform resource ask — will send a short note with required FTE and infra delta by 4pm.

anya: Sales asks: I'll aggregate the two customers' compliance timelines and attach to the doc. If we can't hit their Q3 needs, we'll offer temporary Dedicated contracts.

raj: After seeing the FTE/infra numbers, if platform cost > 20% of infra budget we should consider phasing SLAs (target p99 for top-tier customers first).

lisa: +1 to the updated doc with the H100 carve and Private KR as written.

darrell: +1 assuming we get the FTE ask and the legal clause in place.

clarice-legal: I'll circulate a draft clause by EOD and flag anything that needs more time.

sophia: OK — action items: mike -> FTE + infra delta (4pm), anya -> customer timelines, clarice -> draft clause, raj -> fallback phasing plan. If everyone is +1 after those updates we'll ship the OKR doc and flag for exec signoff.

mike: Note: there is one technical dependency on Optimize team for caching changes; if we bite off the SLA KR we should schedule a 30m sync with Optimize on Monday.

anya: +1 provisional — once FTE/infra and legal are green.

raj: Flag resolved if phasing plan acceptable. I'll draft it now and post edits in the doc.

okrbuddy-bot: Vote tally updated: sophia: author, lisa: +1, darrell: +1, anya: provisional, mike: pending, raj: provisional, clarice-legal: pending.

sophia: Thanks everyone. I'll hold an 11:30AM sync tomorrow to finalize wording and capture signoffs. Agenda: 1) FTE/infra numbers 2) legal clause 3) rollout phasing. Bring any final customer proof points.

mike: I'll be there — sending the FTE note in 2 hours.

anya: I'll post customer PDFs to the doc before the sync.

darrell: Good plan. If execs want a shorter set, we'll present a 1-slide tradeoff: SLA-first vs Private-first.

sophia: Perfect. See you tomorrow. :thumbsup:
